The ENV Pro Unit is an advanced environmental sensor powered by the BME688 sensor solution. This compact unit is capable of measuring a comprehensive range of environmental parameters, including volatile organic compounds (VOCs), indoor air quality (IAQ), temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure. Its small footprint, broad operating range, simple I2C communication interface, superior performance, and low power consumption make it an ideal choice for weather stations, indoor environmental monitoring, and air quality detection systems. Designed for versatility, the ENV Pro Unit operates reliably across an impressive range of environmental conditions: from 300hPa to 1100hPa pressure, 0% to 100% humidity, and -40°C to 85°C temperature. This robust performance ensures functionality from sea-level to high-altitude regions, enduring diverse extreme conditions including dryness, humidity, cold, and heat. Distinguishing itself from previous ENV series products, the ENV Pro Unit not only measures temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure but also integrates advanced capabilities for VOC measurement and gas scanning. It offers exceptional sensitivity, detecting gases down to the parts per billion (ppb) level. The gas scanning functionality is highly customizable, allowing users to tailor sensitivity, selectivity, data rate, and power consumption to meet specific application requirements. Users can leverage the BME AI-Studio tool to train the ENV Pro Unit for specialized applications in areas such as home appliances, IoT products, or smart homes. It provides digital output for various parameters, including air quality index (IAQ), volatile organic compounds (VOC) and CO2 equivalent (ppm), as well as gas scanning results (%) and intensity levels (%). This rich data output facilitates advanced AI data analysis for smarter environmental insights.
